V3_date_wrapper_contract.configuration: calcSearch.setSimpleSearchConfig clones pageOption.simpleSearch entry matching COL_CD and forwards it to the external generated control. Optional isRemoveCalcFromFN changes control configuration. Dates/shortcut type mappings are not defined there.
V3_date_wrapper_contract.date_control: calcSearch.date onInitControl uses settingInfo.dateType or widget.multiDate, optional inlineMode/initialSelect, forwards simpleSearch config, and sets _DATE extraction format yyyyMMdd. dateChanger uses same forwarding with different CALC required-item option.
V3_date_wrapper_contract.serialization: calcSearch.date.onSetSearchParam has separately configured single-date/baseDate lookback handling and isFromPrint overrides. Those branches do NOT identify or prove 종료일 key17 semantics. Optional page settingInfo.onSetSearchParam can override.
V3_date_wrapper_contract.month_calendar_branch: onChangeControl normalizes first/last day of selected months only when settingInfo.useMonthCalender true. This is a calendar setting, not proof of 금월5/전월6/전월+금월9 shortcuts.
V3_date_wrapper_contract.restoration: onRestoreUserTabWidget optionally matches automationOption.simpleSearchDataBySendDate SHORTCUT_NM to existing serialized fn and applies supplied FROM_DATE/TO_DATE. It consumes dates rather than defining shortcut arithmetic.

V56_related_search_contract.query_boundary: Generic status search builds conditions/sorts/groups from search DMC, then SelectInventoryStatusProgram invokes /ec56/api/inventory/action/SelectInventorySearchStatusAction. No exact shortcut17 dispatch into this path was found.
V56_related_search_contract.panel_hide: InventoryStatusUpdateVMCStateBeforeSearchResolver prepares display_search_panel=false/display_search_button=true for ordinary search; EXCEL preserves existing panel/button visibility. This supports generic search-panel hide behavior, not the identity of the triggering shortcut.
V56_related_search_contract.header_reset: HEADER search clears quick search terms, resets page1 and configured limit, reapplies default sort and resets virtual-scroll runtime. No date field change occurs in this header resolver.
V56_related_search_contract.condition_preservation: After search, InventoryStatusUpdateVMCStateAfterSearchResolver calls setPageData; it deep-copies current search DMC into ILastSearchDataModelRuntime and stores last template. It stores search_options except EXCEL. F3 reopen handler itself is outside inspected bodies, so restoration remains UI-observed rather than fully source-traced.
